name: seedream-5-0-pro
description:
Seedream 5.0 Pro creates premium images from text prompts and reference images, with strong detail, composition, and multi-reference fusion. Use it for product concepts, style exploration, image edits, and polished visual assets across 1K and 2K output.

Input limits
- Up to 10 reference images
- One generated image is returned per request

This bot supports optional parameters for additional customization.
